## Observation
Found while verifying d724 AC10 on Windows sweep run 35551741150 (2026-09-21). `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store` fails on the Windows runner. The runner has no OpenSSH that `rebar.attest.sshsig.ssh_keygen_version()` can find, and op-cert signing needs OpenSSH 8.9 or newer. Not a d724 defect class.

## Checked (2026-10-25)
The job log for that run (job 106187634058) ends the test with `rebar.attest.sshsig.SshKeygenUnavailable: ssh-keygen (OpenSSH) not found; SSHSIG requires OpenSSH >= 8.9`, so the ticket's cause holds. The same cause fails 24 distinct tests in 5 modules in that log (this test, 11 in test_opcert_local_verify_binding.py, 9 in test_attestation_invalidation.py, 2 in test_opcert_binding_thread_propagation_ff4a.py, 1 in test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py). Three other opcert modules already skip on the same condition with a module-level `_SSH_OK` probe built on `sshsig.ensure_available()`.

## Decision (user, 2026-10-25)
Skip the test with a clear reason when OpenSSH is older than 8.9 or missing; do not change the Windows workflow. Per-store key isolation stays untested on Windows until a runner has OpenSSH 8.9 or newer. The user also chose to fix the version probe itself for Windows banners, tracked in coldwater-dermoid-rattail (4803-05ae-23bc-4403); this skip stays as the fallback for runners that really lack OpenSSH 8.9.

## Plan
In `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py` only:
1. Add a small helper `_skip_without_sshsig()` that calls `sshsig.ensure_available()` and turns `sshsig.SshKeygenUnavailable` (and only that) into `pytest.skip` with a reason that names the exception text and says per-store opcert key isolation is not asserted.
2. Call it first in `test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store`, and in `test_copied_opcert_signing_keys_are_owner_only` AFTER its existing POSIX-mode skip (that test skips on Windows before it reaches ssh, citing 47d8-baf8-2348-45c9, and that reason must not change; on a POSIX host with an old ssh it fails the same way, 2 of the 14 tests in this module fail under an OpenSSH 8.8 shim). No module-level skip: the other 12 tests in this module do not need ssh.
3. Add unit tests of the helper: missing ssh (version None) and an old one (8, 8) skip with the 8.9 floor in the reason; (8, 9) does not skip; any other exception propagates.
Red proof first: with a PATH shim whose `ssh -V` prints `OpenSSH_8.8p1`, run the real test; before the change it fails with SshKeygenUnavailable (the Windows failure, reproduced on this host), after it reports skipped.

Out of scope: the 48 other tests in 4 modules that fail under the same shim (coldwater-dermoid-rattail covers the probe fix that should make them run), provisioning OpenSSH on the runner, and `ssh_keygen_version()` probing `ssh -V` rather than `ssh-keygen -V`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With a PATH shim whose `ssh -V` reports OpenSSH 8.8, both tests (`test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store` and `test_copied_opcert_signing_keys_are_owner_only`) are skipped with a reason naming the 8.9 floor, where before the change the same run failed with SshKeygenUnavailable (checked: both runs of `pytest tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py -rs` recorded in a ticket comment, 2 failed before and 2 skipped after, the other 12 passing in both).
- [ ] With this host's real ssh (OpenSSH 10.3) both tests still run and pass (checked: the same command without the shim reports 14 passed).
- [ ] The helper skips for a missing ssh and for 8.8, proceeds for 8.9, and lets any other exception propagate (checked: the new helper tests pass).
- [ ] Only `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py` changes, and no other test in it changes behaviour (checked: `git diff --stat` lists that one file; collected node ids differ only by the new tests).
- [ ] `make verify` shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is `Verified +1`.

## Testing
```
pytest tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py -q
make verify
```
